# maps/npc_showcase.gd

[Source:1](../../../../maps/npc_showcase.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Owns the autonomous cast and scripted intruder in the NPC showcase.
Builds the yard, starts night/rota/cinematic services and configures act markers.
Garrison inherits this lifecycle while replacing the level geometry and placement.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.
